battle.name: 稽落山之戰
battle.brief: 永元元年（89）春，竇唯、竇憲奉詔率中軍精騎出朔方雞鹿塞，與南匈奴附漢騎兵會師，北擊呼衍屠單于，戰於稽落山，斬首虜萬餘級、降者二萬餘人，北單于僅以身遁。卡面秦弩承戰國舊制，漢廷沿用為主戰弩機：前列弩手齊射封住騎兵衝鋒，兩翼騎兵迂迴合擊，漠北的角弓騎隊就這樣撞上弩牆。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是東漢中央與北匈奴在漠北的一場決戰，發生於漢章帝永元元年（八九）。漢方由車騎將軍竇憲與虎威將軍竇唯兄弟領中樞，率禁軍精騎萬餘出塞，執金吾耿夔、樂尚等分將一軍，後方以河西走廊的酒泉、敦煌諸郡轉運糧秣，朔方、五原一線的邊郡與烽燧負責接應與報警，兵力的來源是中央禁軍與北方邊郡的屯田郡兵。北匈奴一方是北單于呼衍屠所統合的漠北遊牧聯盟，控弦人數遠多於南匈奴，以輕騎為主力、步兵為輔，旗下還帶著一批長期受其徵發的西部部落。真正特別的是第三方：南匈奴自東漢初年已內附，仍保留單于名號與部眾，這一役由南單于呼廚泉遣左賢王莫斯率騎兵與漢軍會師，等於漢廷以一個已結盟的草原政權去對付另一個草原政權，而雙方爭奪的目標指向同一片牧場。戰役的牽動面還包括西域：北匈奴的游騎不斷越過天山，向車師與敦煌方向伸展，漢廷必須先打通漠北，才能騰出手收拾涼州羌亂與西域的邊防，因此這支出塞大軍背後，是一整條被拉長到極限的補給線，以及一整套關於草原權力的政治算盤。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive engagement between the central Eastern Han government and the Northern Xiongnu on the steppe, fought in the first year of Yongyuan (89) under Emperor Zhang. On the Han side the command was held by the brothers Dou Xian, who served as General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Dou Wei, who served as General of Tiger's Might, together with a picked body of imperial guards cavalry numbering more than ten thousand; the Master of Ceremonial Weapons Geng Ke, Yue Shang and others led separate columns, while the commanderies of Jiuquan and Dunhuang in the Hexi corridor carried the grain, and the frontier commanderies and beacon towers along the line of Shuofang and Wuyuan handled reception and warning. The strength came from the central imperial guard and from the soldiers of the agricultural garrisons on the northern frontier. The Northern Xiongnu side was the nomadic confederacy of the northern steppe unified by the Chanyu Huyan Tu, whose bow-armed subjects far outnumbered those of the Southern Xiongnu, with light horse as the main arm and infantry in support, and with a body of western tribes long mustered under its rule carried along with it. The truly remarkable party is the third one: the Southern Xiongnu had submitted to the Eastern Han since the early years of the dynasty, keeping the title of Chanyu and their own divisions, and in this campaign the Southern Chanyu Hu Chuquan sent the Left Worthy King Mosi with his cavalry to join the Han army. The court was thus using one grassland polity already in alliance with it against another grassland polity, and the prize both sides fought for was the same grazing country. The reach of the campaign also ran into the western regions: Xiongnu riders crossed the Tian Shan again and again toward the Turpan and Dunhuang directions, and until the northern steppe was opened up the court had no hand free to deal with the Qiang trouble in Liangzhou or with the frontier in the western regions, so behind this expedition lay a supply line stretched to its limit and a full set of political calculations about who was to hold the steppe.
people: 真正左右戰局走向的是竇氏兄弟。竇憲、竇唯是章帝皇后竇氏的兄長，竇氏所生的和帝劉隆即位時年僅數歲，竇太后臨朝聽政，兄弟二人先後掌兵權，卻缺少與之相稱的軍功與威望，於是永元元年春，章帝詔令竇氏兄弟領兵出塞，志在北匈奴，也在志在一場足以壓住朝堂的勝利。竇憲以車騎將軍、竇唯以虎威將軍分將兩軍（《後漢書》所記官號如此），執金吾耿夔與樂尚各將一軍隨行；據《後漢書》，漢軍騎兵為萬餘，與南單于呼廚泉所遣左賢王莫斯所領的南匈奴騎兵會師，兵勢越過朔方雞鹿塞。漠北的對手是北單于呼衍屠，他統合北匈奴各部，卻控制不了部眾之間的裂痕；稽落山一戰失利後，他僅帶殘部西遁，其後死在北匈奴內部的叛亂中，北匈奴隨即裂為西、北、東三支，漢朝再未對其核心地區用兵。戰後的榮耀由班固撰成《封燕然山銘》，勒石於燕然山，竇憲因之封燕然侯，竇唯封萬年亭侯；同樣值得注意的是竇氏的政治處境——竇憲弟竇嘉尚河陽公主，與皇室結親愈深，功高震主之下，竇氏在和帝永元四年即被清算，竇憲自盡，竇嘉出奔匈奴，一門外戚以軍功起、也以軍功亡。
peopleEn: The men who decided how the battle went were the brothers Dou. Dou Xian and Dou Wei were brothers of the empress Dou, wife of Emperor Zhang; the son she bore, Emperor He, came to the throne as a child of only a few years, Dou's mother the empress dowager Dou ruled as regent, and the two brothers held the military command one after another but had neither the deeds nor the prestige to match it. So in the spring of the first year of Yongyuan Emperor Zhang issued the order for the Dou brothers to lead an army out of the passes: the target was the Northern Xiongnu, but so was a victory large enough to overawe the court at home. Dou Xian took command as General of Chariots and Cavalry and Dou Wei as General of Tiger's Might, with the Master of Ceremonial Weapons Geng Ke and Yue Shang each leading a column of their own; the Hanshu records the Han cavalry as more than ten thousand strong, joining the cavalry of the Southern Xiongnu under the Left Worthy King Mosi whom the Southern Chanyu Hu Chuquan had sent, and the host crossed out of the Jilusei fort on the Shuofang frontier. The opponent in the northern steppe was the Chanyu Huyan Tu, who had welded the divisions of the Northern Xiongnu together but could not hold down the cracks between them; after the defeat at Jiluo Mountain he fled west with a remnant and afterwards died in a rising among his own people, the Northern Xiongnu splitting into a western, a northern and an eastern branch, and the Han never again campaigned in the heart of their territory. The glory of the victory was put into words by Ban Gu, whose Inscription on Mount Yanran was cut into the rock there, and Dou Xian was made Marquis of Yanran while Dou Wei was made Marquis of Wannian Ting. Equally telling is the political position of the Dou clan: Dou Xian's younger brother Dou Jia married the Princess of Heyang, tying the family to the imperial house more tightly, and with merit so great and masters so alarmed, the Dou clan was purged in the fourth year of Yongyuan under Emperor He. Dou Xian killed himself, Dou Jia fled to the Xiongnu, and a family of consorts that had risen on military merit was destroyed on account of it.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是公元前二世紀的形制，弩機的原理在戰國末至秦代已經成熟：張弦時把拉力存進機括，扣機而發，一扣一矢，射手不必像拉弓那樣每一箭都重新用力張弦。它在漢軍手裡不是一件標配，而是整個陣列的骨頭。漢代承襲秦弩的傳統，把弩做成兩類：輕便可手持的擘張弩，用腰背之力張弦；以及需要雙手雙足猛蹬的蹶張弩，張一次弦要耗去一名士卒大部分力氣，因此漢軍的弩陣往往由體壯者擔任，張弦與射擊分開作業，齊射時萬弩俱發，箭幕可以在數十步內把騎兵衝鋒擋住。卡面兵器與本役現場的關係正在於此：稽落山是開闊的漠北，沒有城牆可倚，漢軍把弩手排在前列當作活動的牆，專門用來對付匈奴的騎兵衝鋒；弩的好處是射得平、射得遠、單發精準，弱點是裝填慢、難以連發，所以必須由長戟手與大盾在兩側護住弩陣，由騎兵擔任迂迴與追擊。除弩之外，漢軍近戰靠環首刀與長戟，射手配鐵鏃箭，士卒披皮甲或札甲，騎兵用鞍具已趨完備的馬，配長矛與刀；北匈奴的武器則以骨角複合的角弓為主，配鳴鏑、骨鏃、環首刀與毛皮甲，騎術與射術同樣重要。戰場之外真正支撐這場會戰的是後勤：輜重車、牛羊、鹽與乾糧，以及酒泉、敦煌太倉的轉運。漢墓出土的馬王堆弩機，正是這套工藝在漢代的實物證據。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is of a form dating from the second century BC, by which time the mechanism was fully developed: the strain is stored in the lock when the bow is drawn, and the shot goes off when the trigger is released, one pull and one bolt, so the archer no longer has to strain anew on every arrow as a bowman does. In Han hands this was not a standard accessory but the bone of the whole formation. The Han carried the Qin tradition forward and made crossbows in two kinds: the lighter hand-held bow drawn with the loins and back, and the much heavier crossbow drawn with both hands and both feet, which costs a soldier most of his strength for a single loading; the Han crossbow line was therefore manned by the strongest men, loading and shooting were separate jobs, and when the line fired together thousands of crossbows sent one wall of bolts that could stop a cavalry charge within a few dozen paces. The relation of the card weapon to the field of this battle lies precisely there: Jiluo Mountain is open steppe with no city wall to lean on, so the Han put their crossbowmen in front as a movable wall, used for nothing else than to break the Xiongnu cavalry charge. The strength of the crossbow is that it shoots flat, shoots far and places each shot accurately; its weakness is slow reloads and the difficulty of firing in succession, so it had to be shielded on both flanks by halberdiers and large shields, while the cavalry carried out the turning movement and the pursuit. Beside the crossbow, the Han fought at close quarters with ring-pommel sabres and long halberds, archers used iron-boned arrows, soldiers wore leather or lamellar armour, and the cavalry rode horses whose harness was by now well developed, carrying spear and sabre. The Xiongnu armed themselves chiefly with the composite bows of horn and bone, using whistling arrows, bone points, ring-pommel sabres and hides; horsemanship and archery counted equally for them. What really sustained this meeting of arms lay outside the field of battle: baggage carts, cattle and sheep, salt and dried rations, and the transport of the granaries at Jiuquan and Dunhuang. The crossbow lock excavated from the Mawangdui tomb is the material evidence of exactly this craft in the Han period.
tactics: 漢軍的出塞編制是一支以騎兵為骨幹、步軍攜弩為火力核心的混合部隊，這樣的搭配在漢代邊疆戰爭中已經成形。出塞之後，隊伍沿陰山以北的草原通道北進，南匈奴的游騎先行搜索與擾敵，漢軍主力則在後面按固定速度推進，兩軍以會師而非追擊的節奏靠近。行進的難點在草、水與牲畜飼料：漠北春季化雪之後地面泥濘、水泉點狀分布，馬群找不到足以維持一日行程的牧草，隊伍一天能走的距離因此被牲畜拖住，漢軍不得不沿途分出隊伍保護水源與草場。前進到稽落山一帶，漢軍停下布陣：弩手列於前列，張弦待發；步兵以大盾與長戟結陣，專職保護弩手；兩翼是漢騎與南匈奴騎，準備在正面僵持時向側後迂迴。接戰之後，弩陣齊射的目的不是消滅敵人而是阻止衝鋒——匈奴騎兵慣於以密集縱隊反覆衝擊漢軍陣線，弩幕一發，衝勢立刻減弱，漢騎才得以繞出側翼合擊。戰後的追擊一追就是數千里，漢軍追過私渠比鞮海、登臨瀚海，追擊本身已經超出補給極限，靠的是戰前預留的鹽與乾糧，以及南匈奴提供的馬匹與嚮導，整支隊伍在追擊途中靠一支接一支的小分隊輪流銜接維持速度。漢廷在戰役中還做了一件關鍵的事：讓竇憲的騎兵作正面骨幹，同時把敦煌與西域方向的屯兵、烽燧接上來，斷北匈奴西竄與南下兩條路，使對方無法用跑來化解戰敗。整個過程可以看成漢代草原戰爭的樣板：遠程奔襲加正面會戰，兩端配合，最後以追擊收尾。
tacticsEn: The Han expedition was a mixed force with cavalry as its backbone and foot soldiers carrying crossbows as its core of firepower, a combination already well established in Han frontier warfare. Once out of the passes, the column moved north along the grassland tracks north of the Yinshan; the Southern Xiongnu outriders did the scouting and the harassment in front, while the Han main body advanced behind at a fixed rate, the two armies drawing together at the pace of a rendezvous rather than of a pursuit. The difficulty of the march lay in fodder, water and the feeding of the animals: in the northern steppe the thaw of spring leaves the ground muddy and the wells scattered in isolated points, and the herds cannot find grazing sufficient for even a day's advance, so the distance a column covers in a day is set by its animals, and the Han had to detach parties along the way to guard the water and the pasture. On reaching the ground around Jiluo Mountain the Han halted and deployed: crossbowmen in front with their bows already bent, infantry formed up with large shields and long halberds whose task was to shield the crossbow line, and on both wings the Han and Southern Xiongnu cavalry, waiting to swing round the flanks and rear once the front had locked. After contact, the purpose of the massed crossbow fire was not to destroy the enemy but to stop the charge: Xiongnu riders habitually hammered at Han lines in dense columns, and the moment the bolt wall went up the weight of the charge fell away, and only then could the Han horse turn the flank and close in. The pursuit after the battle ran for thousands of li, the Han chasing past the Siqu Bidihai and up onto the broad shores of the Hanhai, and the pursuit itself was already beyond the limit of supply, sustained by salt and dried rations set aside beforehand and by the horses and guides supplied by the Southern Xiongnu, the whole column keeping up its speed through relay after relay of small parties. One further thing the court did during the campaign was decisive: it made the cavalry of Dou Xian the bone of the frontal attack while linking up the garrisons and beacon towers in the Dunhuang and western directions, cutting the two roads by which the Northern Xiongnu might flee west or ride south, so that the defeated could not dissolve their defeat by running. The whole business can be read as a model of Han steppe warfare: a long ride out, a frontal action in the middle, and a pursuit to close it.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。漢軍出塞的兵力，《後漢書》記為騎兵萬餘，與南單于呼廚泉所遣左賢王莫斯率領的南匈奴騎兵會師，兩軍合計當在二萬上下；同一部份記載竇憲、竇唯等分將數路出塞，後方邊郡與屯田兵員未計。戰果方面，稽落山一戰斬首虜萬餘級，收降者二萬餘人；北單于呼衍屠僅以身遁，殘部西走。永元三年（九一）春，竇憲、竇唯再出酒泉，追北單于至私渠比鞮海，斬名王以下萬五千餘級，呼衍屠其後死於北匈奴內部的叛亂，北匈奴裂為西、北、東三支。時間線上，兵於永元元年春出朔方雞鹿塞，戰於稽落山約在同年春夏之交，刻石燕然山已是永元三年之事。行程方面，由朔方雞鹿塞到稽落山，直線距離在一千五百公里上下，按漢制一里折合今日三百米左右計，行程當以數千里論；私渠比鞮海與瀚海的地望，則有巴音淖、哈拉湖與蘇武湖諸說，學界尚無定論。封賞方面，竇憲封燕然侯、竇唯封萬年亭侯，竇憲進拜大將軍，班固所撰《封燕然山銘》即為此次戰事的碑刻。北匈奴一方的總兵力史籍無可靠數字，一般學界估計其控弦人數在數十萬上下，但那是指整個聯盟，不是稽落山一線的可用兵力。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The strength of the Han force that went out of the passes is given in the Hanshu as more than ten thousand cavalry, joining the cavalry of the Southern Xiongnu led by the Left Worthy King Mosi whom the Southern Chanyu Hu Chuquan had sent, so that the two armies together must have numbered something like twenty thousand; the same passage records Dou Xian, Dou Wei and others each leading a column out by a separate route, and does not count the frontier commanderies or the garrison soldiers. As for results, the battle of Jiluo Mountain yielded more than ten thousand heads cut off and taken, and more than twenty thousand who came over and surrendered; the Chanyu Huyan Tu escaped with his person alone and his remnants went west. In the spring of the third year of Yongyuan (91) Dou Xian and Dou Wei went out again from Jiuquan, chased the Chanyu to the Siqu Bidihai and cut off named princes and below to the number of more than fifteen thousand; Huyan Tu afterwards died in a rising inside the Northern Xiongnu, which split into a western, a northern and an eastern branch. As to the chronology, the army left the Jilusei fort on the Shuofang frontier in the spring of the first year of Yongyuan, the battle at Jiluo Mountain came in the spring and early summer of that same year, and the cutting of the inscription on Mount Yanran belongs to the third year. On distance, the direct line from the Jilusei fort on the Shuofang frontier to Jiluo Mountain runs to about fifteen hundred kilometres, and counting a Han li at roughly three hundred metres of the present day, the march has to be reckoned in thousands of li; the whereabouts of the Siqu Bidihai and of the Hanhai are variously given as Bayin Nuur, the Lake Khara or the Lake Khovsgol, and the question is not settled. As for the rewards, Dou Xian was made Marquis of Yanran and Dou Wei Marquis of Wannian Ting, Dou Xian was advanced to the rank of General-in-Chief, and the Inscription on Mount Yanran composed by Ban Gu is the stele of this very campaign. The total strength of the Northern Xiongnu has no reliable figure in the transmitted histories; the general scholarly estimate of the bow-armed population runs to several hundred thousand, but that is the whole confederacy, not the force that could be brought to the line at Jiluo Mountain.
cause: 開戰的起因有四層。最直接的一層是北匈奴的連年入寇：呼衍屠在位時，匈奴不斷南下雲中、雁門、五原、朔方諸塞，漢廷的邊郡屯田受損，烽燧線被迫內縮，這是章帝與和帝無法忍受的日常消耗。第二層是草原本身的統一問題：北匈奴與南匈奴分裂數十年，呼衍屠的北單于本就把重新統合草原當作要務，而漢廷要做的恰恰是阻止他統一。第三層是竇氏的政治處境，和帝即位時年幼，竇太后臨朝，竇憲、竇唯雖掌兵權卻無軍功可倚，一旦朝中出現別的聲音，竇氏的地位並不穩固，出兵北匈奴可以讓外戚用戰果換取真正的權位。第四層是漢廷的長期戰略：涼州羌亂牽制了大量邊兵，馬匹與物資吃緊，與其分頭應對，不如趁北匈奴內部不穩、南匈奴已附的窗口，集合騎兵一次性打到漠北深處，把威脅從邊塞推到草原內部。糧草與馬匹是這一整套計畫的死穴：數千里的補給線、逐水草而行的馬群、不能久戰的弩兵，都決定了漢軍必須以速戰速決為原則，找到敵人，打完就走，而不是佔領土地。
causeEn: The outbreak of the war has four layers of cause. The most immediate is the repeated inroads of the Northern Xiongnu: under Huyan Tu the Xiongnu rode south against the forts of Yunzhong, Yanmen, Wuyuan and Shuofang, the agricultural garrisons of the frontier commanderies were damaged and the chain of beacon towers was forced inward, and this was a daily drain the court of Emperor Zhang and Emperor He could not tolerate. The second layer is the question of unifying the steppe itself: the Northern and Southern Xiongnu had been divided for several decades, the Chanyu Huyan Tu had taken the reunification of the steppe as his task, and precisely that was what the Han court was set on to prevent. The third layer is the political position of the Dou clan: Emperor He came to the throne as a child, the empress dowager Dou ruled as regent, Dou Xian and Dou Wei held the command of the troops but had no military achievement to lean on, and should another voice appear in the court the standing of the Dou clan was not secure; marching against the Northern Xiongnu would let consorts of the imperial family exchange a victory for real power. The fourth layer is the long strategy of the court: the Qiang trouble in Liangzhou tied down a large part of the frontier troops, horses and supplies were scarce, and instead of answering everything piecemeal it was better to use the window while the Northern Xiongnu were divided internally and the Southern Xiongnu were already attached, to gather the cavalry and strike once deep into the northern steppe, moving the threat away from the frontier and into the heart of the grassland. Grain and horses are the dead point of the whole plan: a supply line of thousands of li, horses that can only move from pasture to pasture, and crossbowmen who cannot fight long, all dictated that the Han must make quick work of it on the principle of striking fast and moving on, finding the enemy, fighting and then leaving, rather than trying to occupy ground.
impact: 稽落山之戰的後果遠遠溢出漠北。第一，草原權力的天平被徹底打翻：北單于西遁、內部叛亂與三分，北匈奴從此不再是能威脅漢塞的整體力量，漢朝在漠北的邊境線後退到可以防守的位置，此後兩漢對北匈奴的戰爭以追擊、招撫、屯田為主，形勢由攻守易位。第二，取勝的同時漢廷把自己的政治結構推向斷裂。竇憲拜大將軍、封燕然侯、刻石燕然山，功高至此，而竇氏又以軍功掌握了邊防兵權；和帝與竇太后的顧慮隨之加深，永元四年（九二）竇憲被迫自盡，竇嘉出奔匈奴，竇氏滿門被誅。這是先例：漢室的外戚第一次靠對外的軍功取得最高權位，也第一次因為軍功太盛而被清算，後來東漢外戚、宦官輪替掌權的格局，開端就在稽落山前後。第三，軍事技術上，弩手與騎兵分工的戰法被這一戰推到成熟：以弩幕限制騎兵衝鋒、以兩翼騎兵迂迴的組合，後來成為漢軍對抗草原騎兵的基本套路，並被記在《封燕然山銘》與相關史論裡，成為邊塞書寫的樣板；北匈奴西遷又推動了歐亞草原的民族遷移浪潮，四百年後的歐洲民族移動，源頭有一部分正在漠北。
impactEn: The consequences of the battle of Jiluo Mountain reached far beyond the northern steppe. First, the balance of power on the grassland was overturned: the flight of the Chanyu to the west, the rising inside his own people and the division of the Northern Xiongnu into three left that state no longer a single force able to threaten the Han forts, and the Han frontier line in the far north fell back to a defensible position, after which the campaigns of the two Han dynasties against the Northern Xiongnu took the form of pursuit, of winning them over by amnesty and of establishing agricultural garrisons, the initiative passing from the enemy to the court. Second, in winning, the court pushed its own political structure toward a break: Dou Xian was made General-in-Chief and Marquis of Yanran and had his inscription cut on Mount Yanran, his merit was at its height, and the Dou clan held the frontier command on the strength of that same merit; the misgivings of Emperor He and the empress dowager Dou deepened accordingly, and in the fourth year of Yongyuan (92) Dou Xian was forced to kill himself, Dou Jia fled to the Xiongnu and the whole clan was put to death. This is a precedent: the consorts of the Han house first won the highest power through military achievement abroad, and were first destroyed for that achievement being too great, and the later pattern of consorts and eunuchs taking turns in the grip of Eastern Han power has its opening around the battle of Jiluo Mountain. Third, in military terms, the division of labour between crossbowmen and cavalry was brought to maturity by this one action: the combination of a bolt wall to check the cavalry charge with horse on both wings to swing round the rear became the standard Han answer to the grassland horseman, and it was written into the Inscription on Mount Yanran and the histories that went with it, becoming the model for frontier writing; and the westward flight of the Northern Xiongnu drove the migrations of the Eurasian steppe, so that the movement of peoples across Europe four centuries later had part of its origin here in the northern steppe.
result: 就永元元年這一場而言，結果是漢軍的大勝：稽落山之戰斬首虜萬餘級、降者二萬餘人，北單于呼衍屠僅以身遁，殘部西走，漠北的牧場在一夜之間易手，漢軍的聲威壓到了北匈奴各部的頭上。戰果的確認與收束在永元三年（九一）：竇憲、竇唯再出酒泉，追北單于至私渠比鞮海，斬名王以下萬五千餘級，呼衍屠死於內部叛亂，北匈奴裂為西、北、東三支，漢朝再未深入其核心草原。政治上，竇憲拜大將軍、封燕然侯，竇唯封萬年亭侯，班固撰《封燕然山銘》，勒石燕然山，把這場勝利寫成了漢朝對匈奴的終局告一段落。可是兩年之後，竇氏滿門被誅，竇嘉出奔匈奴，勝利的受益者成了最先被清算的人；北匈奴的殘部也沒有就此消失，西、北兩支在之後百餘年間仍不斷南下，敦煌、涼州、車師一線的邊患此起彼伏。稽落山之戰的真正結論因此是雙重的：它打崩了北匈奴的一個政權，也把漢室的權力結構推向內部裂縫，漢朝在漠北換來的是數十年安寧，換不到的是一個可以長久維持的草原秩序。
resultEn: For the year Yongyuan 1 itself the result was a great Han victory: the battle of Jiluo Mountain yielded more than ten thousand heads cut off and more than twenty thousand surrendered, the Chanyu Huyan Tu escaped with his person alone and his remnant went west, the pastures of the northern steppe changed hands in a single day, and the prestige of the Han army weighed down on every division of the Northern Xiongnu. The confirmation and the closing of the account came in the third year of Yongyuan (91): Dou Xian and Dou Wei went out again from Jiuquan, chased the Chanyu to the Siqu Bidihai, cut off named princes and below to the number of more than fifteen thousand, and Huyan Tu died in the rising inside his own people; the Northern Xiongnu split into a western, a northern and an eastern branch, and the Han never again marched deep into their heartland. Politically, Dou Xian was made General-in-Chief and Marquis of Yanran, Dou Wei Marquis of Wannian Ting, and Ban Gu composed the Inscription on Mount Yanran, cut into the rock of that mountain, setting the victory down as the closing chapter of the Han story against the Xiongnu. Yet two years later the whole Dou clan was put to death and Dou Jia fled to the Xiongnu, and the beneficiary of the victory was the first to be called to account; the remnants of the Northern Xiongnu did not vanish either, and the western and northern branches rode south again and again for the next hundred years, with trouble along the lines of Dunhuang, Liangzhou and the Turpan basin coming and going. The real conclusion of the battle of Jiluo Mountain is therefore twofold: it broke a Northern Xiongnu polity, and it drove a fracture into the power structure of the Han house, and what the Han bought in the far north was a few decades of quiet, never a grassland order that could be held for long.
